commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Francisco Maeso has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Akor Adams (Sevilla) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+7' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Francisco Maeso blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Sevilla.
90+5' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) is adjudged offside.
90+4' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 14:11.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is coming onto the pitch as Djibril Sow cannot continue after picking up an injury.

87' A cross by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.

86' He should have scored! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Orjan Nyland makes an easy save.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jesus Areso walks off the pitch to be replaced by Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao).
83' Ernesto Valverde has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) replacing Nico Williams.
82' Substitution. Nemanja Gudelj walks off the pitch and Marcao (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
81' 3 - 2 Goal! Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the right post. 3:2.
79' One of the players from Sevilla times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' The substitution is prepared. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
77' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and Francisco Maeso immediately signals a free kick.
77' There's an opportunity for Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
77' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
74' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
74' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
72' 2 - 2 Goal! Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the left post.
71' That's the end of the game for Castrin, who is replaced by Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla).
71' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

70' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Unai Simon.
70' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
69' The Sevilla players are exchanging some short passes.
67' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) replaces Maroan Sannadi.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Berenguer trots off the pitch and is replaced by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
66' Akor Adams (Sevilla) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
65' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the right post.
65' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
63' Akor Adams (Sevilla) produced a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Unai Simon thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
62' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.

60' 2 - 1 Juanlu Sanchez produces a killer pass to release Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla), who then unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and scores! The ball goes in off the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 2:1!

57' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Unai Simon pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the middle of the target.
56' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
55' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Sevilla are going to take it.
54' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
54' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
53' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
53' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
52' A long pass into the box is latched onto by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao), who looks up and slams a terrific shot past the keeper but onto the right post. He did everything right but score!
50' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
49' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Sevilla was in an offside position.
47' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
46' Matias Almeyda makes a switch. Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) is coming on in place of Stanis Idumbo at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' 4 - 3 The end of the first half.
45+1' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is behind the touchline and Ath Bilbao will take a throw-in.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
45' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
43' 2 - 0 Nico Williams provides Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
42' The ball possession at the moment is 58:42.
40' The referee blows his whistle as Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) was too aggressive in his challenge.
39' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
37' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francisco Maeso had an easy-decision to make.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Orjan Nyland into the bottom right corner.
36' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
36' Referee Francisco Maeso is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Ath Bilbao!
35' Celebrations by Ath Bilbao are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
34' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. It's a penalty for Ath Bilbao!
32' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
30' Djibril Sow (Sevilla) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
30' Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
28' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Akor Adams (Sevilla) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
27' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
24' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Orjan Nyland comes off his line to gather the ball.
23' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player.
22' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
21' Francisco Maeso blows the whistle, Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) is penalised for a foul.
21' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
20' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
20' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
19' Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Francisco Maeso couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) and blew his whistle.
17' Kike Salas (Sevilla) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
14' The ball is cleared after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' The corner from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared away by the defence.
12' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The referee signals a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
11' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner with a short pass.
11' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
11' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
8' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
7' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Castrin (Sevilla) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Francisco Maeso ignores the protests.
5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao).
4' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
4' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
3' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
2' Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Ath Bilbao will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
